$comment: Generated from fairness.yaml by `uv run dd-gen-schema <path to fairness.yaml>`. Do not edit.

DocumentVersionRef.description: One version of a project document: the document the conductor minted an identifier for, and the version's number within it, counted from 1.

document_id.description: The identifier the conductor minted for the document, a UUIDv7.

version.description: The number of a version within its document, counted from 1.

DocumentVersionRef.title: DocumentVersionRef

FairCheck.description: One check of the record against a FAIR sub-principle.

principle.description: The FAIR sub-principle the check bears on, e.g. F1 or R1.1.

check.description: The check's short identifier in checks.yaml, e.g. identifier-is-doi.

met.description: Whether the record, as given, meets the check.

after_deposit.description: True when a draft does not meet the check because the repository supplies what it checks at deposit, such as the DOI and how the data are accessed. Such a check is not counted as assessed and has no recommendation.

newly_met.description: Whether the draft meets the check and the version a person approved last did not. Absent when there is no approved version to compare with.

recommendation.description: A suggestion for retrofitting the record when the check is not met. Absent when it is met.

recommendation_derivation.description: How the recommendation came about: template, the rule table's own text, or model, where a model wrote it for this record. Absent when the check is met.

FairCheck.title: FairCheck

GroundingRef.description: The identity and content hash of one retrieved thing a payload rests on. The only way a payload may name an external resource as a decided identity, and the only place it names it: what the reference identifies is read from the evidence item with the same source_id and content_hash (docs/specs/grounding.md). The linter matches every GroundingRef against a retrieval span on both fields.
GroundingRef.title: GroundingRef

PrincipleTally.description: How many of the checks bearing on one FAIR principle the record meets, of those assessed. A count of presence checks, not a score.

principle_group.description: The FAIR principle, by its letter.

tally_met.description: How many of the principle's assessed checks the record meets.

tally_assessed.description: How many of the principle's checks were assessed.

PrincipleTally.title: PrincipleTally

description: The payload of advisor.fairness: which of a short list of FAIR-related checks the record meets, what is already met first, a tally of the checks for each of F, A, I and R, the next steps most worth taking, and a suggestion for each check not met. For a draft it also says which checks are newly met since the version a person approved last. A tally is a count of presence checks, not a FAIR score (R4). It is advisory and changes no record (R9, R12); the researcher decides what to change.

schema_class.description: Type designator: the name of the class this object is an instance of. Discriminates the input and payload unions, and lets a consumer name a payload class it does not recognise.

principle_tallies.description: A tally for each of F, A, I and R, in that order.

next_steps.description: The identifiers of the one or two checks not met that are most worth acting on now, best first, ranked by the rule table's priority.

assessed_version.description: The version of the project's metadata record assessed, for a draft.

compared_with.description: The version a person approved last, which newly_met compares with. Absent when none was approved, or when it is the version assessed.

limitations.description: What this assessor does not do.

grounded_on.description: The retrieved things this object rests on. For grounding mode retrieval, each entry names a retrieval span; for input_only and none, the single entry is the input itself (source_id input:<invocation_id>, content_hash the dd-input-json-v1 hash).

title: FairnessReport
